---
format:
  revealjs:
    slide-level: 2
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
extensions:
  veil:
    toast: main
    groups:
      - name: advanced
        level: 1
        shown: true
        label: Advanced
      - name: expert
        level: 2
        shown: false
        label: Expert
      - name: backup
        shown: false
        label: Backup
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The interface in Reveal.js, with the toast option main.
        check: "node veil-check.mjs"
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
---
